styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "PingFang SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #3f3f3f !important; background-color: #8863cf; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96) 0%, rgba(249, 247, 252, 0.96) 100%); border-radius: 22px; padding: 34px; margin: 28px 0; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(136, 99, 207, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(136, 99, 207, 0.4); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.4s ease;
styles.innerContainer::before: content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c9a8ee, #8863cf, #c9a8ee); opacity: 0.8;
styles.ol > li: position: relative; counter-increment: item; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-left: 40px;

dark-mode.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "PingFang SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #d0c0f0 !important; background-color: #2a1a4a; word-wrap: break-word;
dark-mode.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(42, 26, 74, 0.96) 0%, rgba(35, 20, 60, 0.96) 100%); border-radius: 22px; padding: 34px; margin: 28px 0; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(136, 99, 207, 0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(136, 99, 207, 0.6); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.4s ease;
dark-mode.innerContainer::before: content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a080d0, #8863cf, #a080d0); opacity: 0.9;
dark-mode.ol > li: position: relative; counter-increment: item; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-left: 40px;
